taps.phrase: courir sur un tapis de course

question: Que fait la femme au premier plan ?
notes: 's'essuyer le front' instead of 'le visage': she wipes her forehead with her forearm (accept 'visage' too). 'au premier plan' (B1) is the natural French way to single her out from the woman in the background; alternative 'la femme devant' is less idiomatic. All three boxes cover the same woman for the whole clip; the button press is in box_01/box_05, the wipe in box_05/box_06. The key word gap in tap row 1 is the whole compound 'tapis de course'.
